title: Webhook Reconciliation
summary: Catch every incoming webhook, check it against the source system, and fix mismatches automatically instead of finding them in a monthly audit.
problem: Webhooks get dropped, duplicated or arrive out of order. When a payment or order event goes missing, nobody notices until a customer complains or the books don't balance.
trigger: Incoming webhook (e.g. payment or order event)

steps.name: Receive webhook
steps.detail: The workflow starts when the provider sends an event.

steps.name: Normalize & dedupe
steps.detail: Map the payload to one shape and skip events already processed.

steps.name: Fetch source of truth
steps.detail: Look up the same record in the provider's API.

steps.name: Compare
steps.detail: Branch on whether the webhook and the source record match.

steps.name: Repair record
steps.detail: Update your system when the records disagree. Retries handle flaky APIs.

steps.name: Alert on failure
steps.detail: Post to Slack or Teams only if the repair still fails.

outcome: Every event is accounted for, mismatches are fixed within minutes, and each run can be replayed step by step.

title: Automated Lead Enrichment
summary: Turn a bare email from a signup form into an enriched, scored lead that lands with the right rep, without anyone copying data between tabs.
problem: New leads arrive with only a name and email. Reps waste time researching them by hand, and good leads sit untouched while bad ones get attention.

steps.name: New lead arrives
steps.detail: Triggered by a form, signup or CRM event.

steps.name: Enrich in parallel
steps.detail: Call several data providers at once for company and contact details.

steps.name: Summarize & score
steps.detail: An LLM summarizes the company and scores fit against your ICP.

steps.name: Route by score
steps.detail: Hot leads go straight to a rep, the rest go to nurture.

steps.name: Update CRM
steps.detail: Write the enriched record and score back to the CRM.

outcome: Every lead is enriched and routed in seconds, with a full audit trail of where each data point came from.
